title: Kitty Match 3D
description: Dig through an adorable pastel pile of chubby 3D kittens and cozy cat toys, picking three matching cuties at a time to clear every level.
controls: Tap matching 3D cat figures and toys to collect triplets into the bottom dock before it fills up.

zh-CN.title: 3D 喵喵消除
zh-CN.description: 软萌治愈系 3D 猫咪堆叠三消：在满满一桌胖嘟嘟小猫与猫玩具里揪出三只同款配对消除，萌化强迫症。
zh-CN.controls: 点击三只相同的 3D 猫咪或玩具放进底部卡槽完成三消，清空全场即可晋级下一关。
